Swiss Senate Backs Stricter Capital Rules for UBS

Switzerland's upper house of parliament has backed a proposal for stricter capital requirements for the bank UBS. The vote supports a plan mandating that UBS hold 90% of its capital in Switzerland. This decision represents a setback for UBS, which had sought more lenient terms.
